review.scope: Short first-party presentation copy only, not product enrichment or full articles.
review.basis: Exact preview title; archive source_facts only where the archive title matches exactly.
review.claimPass: Removed unsupported form/material/bundle and compatibility expansions from truncated titles; no assumed image details, health claims or supplier freshness claims.
review.parallelPart: Final 293 entries incorporate corrected assets part commit 9fe54170c92cd9e78160fda6440db741dcac99aa.
review.limitedTitleHandling: When the title does not identify a product form, retain its known theme/wording without guessing a form. Some lines deliberately say item or design.
review.unresolvedIdentityReason: Brand-only title; matching source facts establish beige and kitchen category but not the object's form. Copy remains explicit about that limited information.
review.acceptanceBoundary: Automated length/coverage/string checks do not establish product truth or public deployment; parent performs independent copy and consumer/build review.

requiredConsumerGuards: Exact product ID and exact title match.
Use only when the original short description is the approved generic fallback.
Keep existing substantive descriptions and curated notes preferred.
Do not rewrite supplier, editorial, identity, native-vector or database fields.
